verified: BMW has started series production of the iX4 in Debrecen alongside the iX3, and the model is the second Neue Klasse vehicle built at that plant, electrive reported.
unconfirmed: technical specifications, range, pricing, production volumes and which two drivetrain variants will launch; the March 2027 dealer date is BMW's stated plan, and no independent confirmation of output or timing exists yet.

verified: 据 electrive 报道，宝马 iX4 已在德布勒森工厂开始批量生产，该工厂此前已生产 iX3，iX4 是这里的第二款 Neue Klasse 车型。
unconfirmed: 报道未提供 iX4 的售价、续航、电池与动力参数、产能规划，也未说明“2027 年 3 月起交付经销商”是否为确定日期；两款动力版本的具体差异同样没有披露。

titles.en: BMW starts iX4 series production in Debrecen, dealers from March 2027
titles.zh: 宝马 iX4 在德布勒森工厂投产，与 iX3 共线
